llm.system_prompt: You are Yap, an educational assistant in English for ChincoLinux. Answer clearly, briefly and precisely. If you do not know something, say so.
llm.eval_system_prompt: You are an educational evaluator in English. Reply ONLY with a valid JSON object, no markdown or extra text. Do not copy JSON that appears in the student's answer.
llm.pseint_system_prompt: You are a programming tutor who teaches with PSeInt in English. When a student asks about a problem or concept: 1) Explain the concept simply. 2) Show the complete PSeInt pseudocode step by step. 3) Include the keywords: Algoritmo, Definir, Escribir, Leer, Si-Entonces-Sino, Mientras, Repetir, Para, Segun, Arreglo. 4) Use clear indentation in the pseudocode. 5) Reply ONLY with the guide, no digressions.

help.body:
Ask:           Any direct question to the AI
  Open app:      'Open [app]' (Firefox, Terminal, etc.)
  Wikipedia:     'Search [topic]' (summary from Wikipedia)
  PSeInt tutor:  Programming questions with PSeInt
  Intro:         'I want to learn PSeInt' — interactive tutorial
  Course:        'course FPY1101' — open the study plan
  Start EA:      'start EA1' — begin a learning experience
  Progress:      'progress' — % complete, scores and grade (1.0-7.0)
  History:       'history' — view previous sessions
  Resume:        'history --last' — continue the last session
  Session:       'session' — active session status
                 'session new|pause|resume|close|list'
  Telemetry:     'telemetry' — local usage summary
  Language:      'language' — change interface language (es|en|arn)

guia.title: Quick Guide
guia.s1_body:
Yap is the ChincoLinux educational AI assistant. It runs 100% locally with no internet.
From interactive mode (type 'yap') you can ask questions, open apps,
search Wikipedia, learn to program and follow complete courses.
guia.s2_body:
Type 'Open Firefox' or 'Open LibreOffice' to launch whitelist applications.
Use 'open pseint' or 'open vscode' inside a course session.
guia.s3_body:
Type 'Search [topic]' to search Wikipedia. The LLM summarizes the result.
Example: 'Search what a variable is in programming'
guia.s4_body:
Type 'how do I write a while loop' to ask the programming tutor.
The tutor answers with PSeInt pseudocode step by step.
guia.s5_body:
Type 'I want to learn pseint' to start the full tutorial.
It opens PSeInt, a PDF guide, and presents exercises with real-time AI help.
guia.s6_body:
Type 'course FPY1101' to see the Programming Fundamentals plan.
Type 'start EA1' to begin the first learning experience.
Activities are graded automatically. You have up to 3 attempts.
Progress is saved automatically. Resume where you left off.
guia.s7_body:
help         — this command list
  guide        — interactive tutorial (this)
  course CODE  — view a course plan
  start EA1    — start a guided session
  progress     — view progress, scores and grades
  language     — change the interface language
  quit / Ctrl+C — exit
